defects.description: NameError: name 'page_info' is not defined during RAG knowledge block string formatting when adding bounding box calculation.
defects.root_cause: The page_info string interpolation was deleted when replacing citation dictionary generation.
defects.remediation: Restored page_info = f' (Page {item.page_number})' if item.page_number else '' before knowledge_blocks.append.

defects.description: TypeError: LLMProviderRegistry.get_provider() got an unexpected keyword argument 'strict'.
defects.root_cause: get_provider method signature did not accept the strict parameter passed in provider reliability test.
defects.remediation: Added strict: bool = False to get_provider parameter list.

defects.description: PostgreSQL pg_dump backup script does not automatically capture raw uploaded files stored in STORAGE_PATH or S3 bucket.
defects.root_cause: Database backup scripts are scoped to database engines and do not encompass file storage volumes.
defects.remediation: Documented requirement for concurrent volume snapshotting/S3 bucket replication in operational readiness report and deployment instructions.

defects.description: PyMuPDF parser does not extract span-level bounding box coordinates during ingestion, necessitating deterministic standard viewport fallback.
defects.root_cause: PDFParser calls page.get_text('text') rather than page.get_text('words') or page.get_text('blocks').
defects.remediation: Classified as FALLBACK_SYNTHETIC in citation provenance results and scheduled for post-M05 parser enhancement.
